evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MMDS-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for multimodal dynamic stance classification in social media parent-reply interactions.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing work has mainly studied this problem in text-only settings, while social media interactions increasingly rely on images, screenshots, memes, reaction images, and cross-modal references.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: MMDS-Bench contains 3,482 multimodal instances annotated with a seven-label dynamic stance taxonomy, together with an 800-instance diagnostic subset that requires structured reasoning over parent understanding, reply understanding, and stance-relation inference.
